criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?
The Point constructor throws an Error when x or y is NaN, with a message referencing the invalid coordinate value(s).
The Point constructor coerces string numeric inputs to numbers (stored x/y are of number type), defaults pressure to 0 when falsy/absent, and defaults time to the current timestamp when falsy/absent.

distanceTo returns Euclidean distance; equals compares all four fields (x, y, pressure, time) so differing in any one yields false; velocityFrom returns exactly 0 when times are equal and distance/time-difference otherwise.
Bezier control-point computation guards the length-ratio division so coincident adjacent points (l1 + l2 === 0) are treated as ratio 0 and never produce NaN coordinates.

Bezier.fromPoints builds a curve using points[1] as start, points[2] as end, computed control points between, and carries widths.start/widths.end; the point helper computes the standard cubic Bézier polynomial and length() sums sampled segment distances.
SignatureEventTarget constructs a native EventTarget and degrades to using document (or another valid target) when the EventTarget constructor is unavailable, rather than throwing.
addEventListener, removeEventListener, and dispatchEvent delegate to the internal target, and dispatchEvent returns the delegated boolean result rather than a constant.

throttle and minDistance options use nullish handling so an explicit 0 is preserved (throttle default 16, minDistance default 5), while all other options fall back to their documented defaults including for explicit undefined.
The move update goes through the throttled wrapper when throttle > 0 but bypasses throttling (uses the raw update) when throttle is 0.

on() sets both standard and vendor-prefixed canvas styles (touchAction/msTouchAction='none', userSelect/webkitUserSelect='none') and attaches input listeners; off() restores those styles to 'auto' and removes all listeners.

clear() fills with background color, empties the data model, resets stroke state including the active pointer id, marks empty, and clears cached data-URL state; redraw() re-renders from cached URL and stored data without permanently discarding them.
